svg.aria-label: JobPilot entity relationship diagram: 19 MongoDB collections; per-account collections join accounts on userId, pipeline collections join the shared jobs on jobId
svg.title: JobPilot data model
svg.text: PER ACCOUNT — every row carries userId → accounts._id
sourceId → the profile row a chunk was cut from
⚠ matches is unique on jobId alone → 0..1 today
soft link — points at one of several collections
MongoDB enforces none of these references — the server modules keep them consistent. ? = optional · T[] = array of embedded T.
One MongoDB Atlas database (jobpilot), owned by server/. The ai tier holds no connection string: it reaches every collection through the server's REST API.
Foreign keys are plain PydanticObjectId fields, never Beanie Links — ai receives them as JSON over HTTP and cannot dereference a link.
